tool_msgs: zn: ~/.aws/credentials was not read because zn treats it as holding secrets (AWS credentials file), and secret values never go to the model. If a command needs a value, ask the user to run `npx -y zn-gate@1.14.1 secret set NAME`, then run the command with `npx -y zn-gate@1.14.1 run --secrets NAME -- <command>` so the program gets it as an environment variable.
